scope: Complete same-GPU routed-expert spans. No preparation, router network, shared experts, communication, CPU submission or serving throughput. Checkpoint values match; each rounding contract is independently referenced. Expanded FP16 controls require 4x FP4/INT4 or 2x E4M3 weight payload storage.

cases.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
cases.numerical_contract: FP16 input/intermediate/output; Frost FP4/E4M3 rounds preactivation to FP16, MXINT4 retains FP32. Expanded CUTLASS rounds preactivation to FP16; SM120 native retains FP32 preactivation/partials. Each has a separate reference.
cases.native_weight_storage: Native packed four-bit checkpoint
cases.timer: CUPTI single-call first-to-last GPU activity span
cases.native_search: All advertised native choices plus default; cuTile additionally enumerates the selected/all supported block-size stage pairs; SM120 native uses all same-thread small/large-tile pairs; expanded FP16 ranks top-two per stage plus default
